name: L10nParamKind
doc: Parameter types shared by messages, generated bindings and translation jobs.

variants.name: text
variants.doc: User or application text, inserted with bidi isolation.

variants.name: number
variants.doc: Exact decimal, also usable as a plural selector.

variants.name: date
variants.doc: ISO calendar date, formatted in the requested locale's calendar.

variants.name: currency
variants.doc: Exact decimal and ISO 4217 currency code.
